quest.title: All Good Reunions Follow a Search
quest.description: After some searching, you and Paimon arrive at the location indicated by the picture...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000, Gift Egg Gifted by Cacasha x1

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This should be the place from the picture. Look, Ororon and Ifa are here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello!

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Ah, now that sounds like a happy Paimon. Great! No need to be on guard then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please, even an "angry Paimon" is harmless.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh! Watch it, buddy!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: All you gotta do is give her a treat.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Paimon's not Cacucu! You can't just give her a cracker and call it a day...! Okay, maybe that would help...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, y'know what? It doesn't matter! Paimon's in a good mood today, and you're not gonna tease her out of it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold on, speaking of Cacucu... Where is he? Don't tell Paimon the Capybara King gobbled him up?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: What? Do you even hear yourself, bro?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Cacucu has joined hands with the enemy to bully us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bully you? Cacucu? Hahaha, good one, Ororon...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: That wasn't meant to be a joke.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then, this so-called "enemy" is...?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: He said his name was "Cacasha."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so does that mean he's an Asha? An Asha that can talk?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Whoa, hold up. Ororon is... embellishing. Let me explain.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Cacucu is, uh... playing hide-and-seek around here with an Asha.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: And by that, we mean that they're allied against us.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Cacucu is fast, and Cacasha can disguise himself... So, we face a crafty enemy indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: We played round after round with the little guys before you showed up.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: And, listen, Cacucu is a beast at this game. Am I proud of him? Yeah. But man, I am getting worn out...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: It's your own fault for not going to Coach Iansan's fitness class.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: *sigh* Seriously, having to search up and down for these little guys, round after round... My back's killing me!

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Of course it is. Because you didn't go to Coach Iansan's fitness class.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: ...Alright, alright. I get the picture! I'll go when we get back. Happy?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, shouldn't you do a little more seeking right about now? Who's gonna track down Cacucu and Cacasha if you keep bickering like this?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Ah, well, that brings us to the perfectly good lemon that just fell right into our lap...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Me... again?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fine. I'll go.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: #You got this, {M#Gramps}{F#other Granny}! Oh, and you too, Granny Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Just have fun, and call us if you need help.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Wait, I thought we were gonna be Ashas as well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no... Please don't tell Paimon you're gonna hide with them and force us to find you too?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: That's right! From now on, I'm "Orasha," and he's "Ifasha." Gotta go hide. Good luck!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Bro! What the...! Gah...

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Sorry, guys. Mind humoring him for a bit?

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Thanks, you two! Guess that means I should get hiding!

choices.text: Don't worry! I have more than enough energy to spare!

talks.objective: Play a thrilling game of hide-and-seek

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh*... We did it, finally! That was too much work.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you must be Cacasha! You and Cacucu make a really impressive duo! And, as part of a formidable duo herself, Paimon would know!

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: Impressive, bro!

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: See what I mean? When those two join forces, it's almost impossible to beat them.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Cacucu, I can officially say you've earned your certificate in the "art of concealment." From now on, you can call yourself a master trickster.

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: Oh, wow! You're the best, bro!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Hey, what about me? I was the one who played with you the most!

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: You're awesome, too, bro!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Huh... I think he has something to give us...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Cacasha presents a Gift Egg to the group...

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Oh! Another Gift Egg, and another picture too. I think I've seen this symbol around the Easybreeze Market...

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Bro... Why does it feel like we've got another challenge coming our way...?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Huh? Is this some kind of secret treasure hunt, hidden around the resort? I have to see it through!

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: See it through, bro!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like Cacucu is having a blast.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Well, you can't have an adventure without {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Whaddaya say, wanna check it out?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Definitely! Let's see it through!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Alright, guess I'm along for the ride, then.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Found it! We were right about the Easybreeze Market!

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: Easybreeze Market!!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Chill, bro. I know you're excited, but we've gotta get the lay of the land first.

dialogues.speaker: Challwa
dialogues.text: Ahem... Step on up, dear patrons! Pick an egg, any egg! Let this be your lucky day!

dialogues.speaker: Challwa
dialogues.text: Test 'em out free of charge! What do you say?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so this is where the picture was leading us. This must be where the Gift Eggs come from.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, hehe... Let's see how far that lucky streak gets us!

dialogues.speaker: Challwa
dialogues.text: S—Step right up! The gift eggs are all set for the picking!

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: You first.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Seriously, bro? Don't tell me you actually buy into the whole "bad luck to go first" thing? ...Fine, fine. Have it your way.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: By the luck of the Asha, gimme something good!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, Saurus Crackers! Score!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Pff...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You don't like Saurus Crackers, Ifa?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Oh, don't get me wrong, we both love 'em. But, when it comes to Gift Eggs, they're not exactly one of the better prizes.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Whatever, anything that tastes good is fine by me. Here, everyone can have some.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Make fun of me all you want, bro. Just wait until you get one of those weird Magma Eggs, and see if I help you then!

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Impossible. You can never resist helping people.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Now... Is there a special ritual I should do before opening the egg?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Whatever you think will bring you good luck, I guess.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Got it. "Flower-Feather Clan Patrol Team — open up!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, it's the Flower-Feather Clan specialty, "Sing Your Heart Out"... Guess that ritual actually worked...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Nice! I'll take anything but Mystique Soup, honestly. I'm so tired of that stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Guess I lucked out with this huge tub of candy! Dig in, everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: You're the best, bro!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After making a meal of the Saurus Crackers, Cacucu crunches away at the candy.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: All the sugar gives everyone a bit of a rush...

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Well, are you happy, buddy? Did you have fun?

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: Oh wow, bro!

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: I think that's a yes. Happy birthday, bro.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Oh, and that reminds me. Why didn't you tell me about the plan, bro? Seriously, bro, bros don't hide things from other bros, bro.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Haha... To be honest, I wanted to see if you remembered the anniversary.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Psh... You've changed, Ifa. How am I supposed to trust you when you betray a bro like that?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Heh... Well, jokes on you, because I did remember. I saved some fresh honey for Cacucu. I know the price of forgetting the anniversary, and I wasn't about to get pecked in the head for a whole year.

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: Wouldn't do that, bro! You're the best!

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: Hello again, bro!

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: Earlier, I was trying to tell Ifa that he got the date wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: But, I stopped myself. I guess part of being mature is knowing when it's better to let things go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cacucu! Cacasha! ...Orasha! Ifasha!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ready or not, here we come...!
